items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Him and Gene Mikell and all of them, all of that group -- I met all of them.

ctx.x: Well, I knew Happy. I met him when I first come here. Him and Gene Mikell and all of them, all of that group -- I met all of them. Tommy Morris, I never met him! I never met him. I heard I think two people in (?) mention his name, Tommy Morris. I don't even know who the two people were now. But he used to put out some nice records.
And then what about Elmer James, the bass player?
